title: Ruddy wool.
html_source:
A reference to Leopold Bloom’s dead son Rudy. Later in the episode Stephen remembers hoping to get a good gawk up a neighbour’s dress as a reference to Bloom staring up Gerty McDowell’s dress on Sandymount Strand later on (during which time he masturbates).

Joyce sees the future for us or at least for rereaders.
